data.one_liner: Pure-Dart structured logging, tracing, filtering, history, observers, export, and redaction core.
data.what_it_does: Provides typed log entries with severity levels, tracing extensions for async/sync/stream operations, bounded in-memory or rolling file history, filter rules, observer hooks, and built-in data redaction for Dart and Flutter applications.
use_when: You need structured logging and tracing in pure Dart or server-side applications without Flutter dependencies.
You want built-in data redaction to mask sensitive tokens, API keys, and credentials before writing to disk or exporting.
avoid_when: You only need the built-in Dart print function for a very small CLI script.
You require a full-fledged hosted crash reporting and analytics backend rather than local history and observation.
strengths: Pure Dart with no mandatory Flutter dependency.
Built-in redaction engine for secure logging.
Supports rolling file history, filtering, observers, and trace extensions.
weaknesses: Must explicitly compile with ISPECT_ENABLED=true for diagnostics to run.
Requires manual setup for advanced features like rolling file history.
data.setup_notes: Add to pubspec.yaml and compile with -DISPECT_ENABLED=true for diagnostics.
